=Overview=
When logging into an AW+ device for the first time (by CLI or by HTTP/S), the user must change their password from the default value. At a high level, this can be considered to follow the below state machine:
[[File:FDPC Overview.png|none|thumb|600x600px]]

==FDPC in detail==
This is represented by an [https://git.atlnz.lc/cgit/cgit.cgi/non-oss/ipc-atl.git/tree/host_common.proto enum] of the following values:
<pre>
PASSWORD_CHANGE_NOT_SET = 0;

// The password does not require changing.
PASSWORD_CHANGE_NOT_REQUIRED = 1;

// Force the password to be changed.
PASSWORD_CHANGE_FORCE_CHANGE = 2;

// Force the password to be changed, but limit this to occur once.
PASSWORD_CHANGE_FORCE_CHANGE_ONCE = 3;

// Warn the user that their password should be changed.
PASSWORD_CHANGE_WARN = 4;
</pre>

In the "Factory-default password" state, the associated check will return either <code>HOST_PASSWORD_CHANGE_FORCE_CHANGE</code> or <code>HOST_PASSWORD_CHANGE_FORCE_CHANGE_ONCE</code>.

The check for this is detailed by the below flowchart:
[[File:FDPC Flowchart.png|none|thumb|1800x600px]]

If the value returned is FORCE_CHANGE or FORCE_CHANGE_ONCE, the default password needs to be changed. If the value is WARN, the user should be shown a warning that their password should be changed from the default. In all other cases, no action is required.

===Default Password Detection===
Currently, we only check that the password has been encrypted with an MD5 hash, as the default-generated config contains this but a user-generated config will not.

This means that the most likely way to see the password warning is if the user has copied the value from the factory-generated config into a new config.

===Bootloader Override===
{{Warning|The value input in the bootloader is offset by 1 from the values in the enum above. This means that for a desired value of 1 (NOT_REQUIRED), def_pwd_chg must be set to 0.}}
The initial value of the check can be overridden with the def_pwd_chg bootloader argument. In the u-boot shell:
<pre>
setenv relargs def_pwd_chg=<value>
save
reset
</pre>

==Login-only Mode==
The HTTP server disallows most APIs when the default password still needs to be changed (i.e. when the device is in the "Factory-default password" state defined above). During this mode, only the APIs which are required for the initial login/password change flow are accessible. These can be seen in [https://git.atlnz.lc/cgit/cgit.cgi/awplus.git/tree/package/appweb/appweb_awplus_login_only.conf the login-only mode config].

Other APIs will return some form of HTTP 403 Forbidden response with the error message <code>API access requires admin password to be configured</code>:
* Apteryx APIs (/api) return the message in plain text.
* CMSG APIs (/api/v[0-9]+/) return ANT_CODE_PERMISSION_DENIED with the error message attached.
* RestCONF returns the below JSON object, based on {{RFC|8040}}{{Note|The RFC specifies that all 4xx codes except 403 should contain the error-message tag, but doesn't specify that 403 should not.}}:
<pre>
{
  "ietf-restconf:errors": {
    "error": [
      {
        "error-type": "application",
        "error-tag": "access-denied",
        "error-message": "API access requires admin password to be configured"
      }
    ]
  }
}
</pre>
